title: Your first trade for Thursday, November 29
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of CVS .
Tim Seymour was a buyer of General Motors .
Steve Grasso was a buyer of the utilities ETF .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Valero .
